Growth and per share.label: Three-year revenue CAGR
Growth and per share.formula: (operating revenue / operating revenue three years earlier)^(1/3) − 1

Liquidity and debt.label: Debt service coverage
Liquidity and debt.formula: operating cash flow / scheduled principal and interest

Cash generation.label: Free cash flow margin
Cash generation.formula: (operating cash flow + signed cash capex) / operating revenue

Asset and working-capital efficiency.label: Payable days
Asset and working-capital efficiency.formula: 365 × average trade payables / cost of sales

Asset and working-capital efficiency.label: Cash conversion cycle
Asset and working-capital efficiency.formula: inventory days + receivable days − payable days

Valuation and distributions.label: Dividend payout ratio
Valuation and distributions.formula: reported dividend per share / annual basic EPS
